lines.zh: 我一步一晃，装作被风吹的叶子。
lines.en: I sway with each step, posing as a windblown leaf.

lines.zh: 六条腿挪得很慢，怕惊动树影。
lines.en: Six legs creep slowly so the shadows stay calm.

lines.zh: 我沿着枝条走，边缘的锯齿对着光。
lines.en: I walk the branch with my jagged edges to the light.

lines.zh: 走一步停一下，我在听林子的动静。
lines.en: A step, a pause; I listen to the forest.

lines.zh: 我的身体是绿的，走在叶间几乎没了。
lines.en: Green as I am, I nearly vanish among the leaves.

lines.zh: 我横着挪，让叶脉一直朝外。
lines.en: I sidle along keeping my veins facing out.

lines.zh: 脚落在叶面很轻，像多长了一片叶。
lines.en: My feet land softly, as if the leaf grew one more.

lines.zh: 我绕过树干，又从另一侧接上。
lines.en: I round the trunk and pick up on the far side.

lines.zh: 走路时我也在摇，摇得和风一样。
lines.en: Even walking I sway, swaying just like wind.

lines.zh: 我从这片叶挪到那片，缝都没露。
lines.en: I shift from leaf to leaf without a seam showing.

lines.zh: 树皮太糙，我换成叶背走。
lines.en: The bark is rough, so I take the leaf's underside.

lines.zh: 我的腹部卷起来，像一片枯了的尖。
lines.en: My abdomen curls like a dried leaf tip.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬高，越往上有越好的光。
lines.en: I climb higher where the light is better.

lines.zh: 我停下抖了抖，把身上的影子抖掉。
lines.en: I stop and shiver the shadows off my back.

lines.zh: 风一停，我才敢走两步。
lines.en: When the wind stops, I dare take two steps.

lines.zh: 我贴着叶缘走，脚不外露。
lines.en: I walk the leaf's edge, my feet hidden.

lines.zh: 我装作一片叶，连呼吸都很轻。
lines.en: I play the leaf, even breathing lightly.

lines.zh: 停在枝上，我让叶脉对齐真叶。
lines.en: On the branch I line my veins up with real ones.

lines.zh: 风停了，我也停下摆动。
lines.en: The wind dies and my swaying stops with it.

lines.zh: 一只鸟落在旁边，我屏住了。
lines.en: A bird lands nearby and I hold everything.

lines.zh: 我把自己卷起来，边缘有点干。
lines.en: I curl up, my edges a little dry.

lines.zh: 森林很吵，蝉、风、还有远处的斧声。
lines.en: The forest is loud: cicadas, wind, an axe far off.

lines.zh: 我尽量不动，等那只鸟走。
lines.en: I keep still until the bird leaves.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过叶隙，落在我的背上。
lines.en: Sun through the canopy lands on my back.

lines.zh: 我抬起前腿，像叶柄被风吹起。
lines.en: I lift a foreleg as if the petiole caught wind.

lines.zh: 有只蚂蚁爬过我，没认出我。
lines.en: An ant walks over me and does not recognize me.

lines.zh: 我把腿收进轮廓里，装得更像了。
lines.en: I tuck my legs into the outline and pass better.

lines.zh: 这片林子安静下来，我才松了一点。
lines.en: The wood quiets down and I relax a little.

lines.zh: 你拨开叶子，我们离得很近。
lines.en: You part the leaves and we are very close.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，眼睛藏在叶脉的影子里。
lines.en: I watch you with eyes hidden in vein shadow.

lines.zh: 你找了我很久，我就站在你眼前。
lines.en: You searched long; I was right in front of you.

lines.zh: 你伸手来摸，我缩成了叶形。
lines.en: Your hand comes near and I shrink into leaf shape.

lines.zh: 我认出你是砍树的那种人。
lines.en: I know your sort: the kind that chops trees.

lines.zh: 你在数树上的叶子，我也在数你。
lines.en: You count the leaves; I count you instead.

lines.zh: 我的头转了一点点，你差点没看见。
lines.en: My head turns a fraction and you nearly miss it.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，视线刚好和我平齐。
lines.en: You crouch until your eyes are level with mine.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，你眼睛跟着晃。
lines.en: I sway once and your eyes sway with me.

lines.zh: 你笑了，我猜你终于看见我了。
lines.en: You smile, and I guess you finally see me.

lines.zh: 我的叶边被撕开一角。
lines.en: A corner of my leaf edge is torn.

lines.zh: 我僵住不动，装作已经枯了。
lines.en: I freeze and pose as something already dead.

lines.zh: 腿断了一条，我爬得很吃力。
lines.en: One leg is gone and crawling is hard.

lines.zh: 我被摔在落叶里，绿和绿混在一起。
lines.en: I land among fallen leaves, green among green.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我也在摇，摇得乱了。
lines.en: Even in pain I sway, but out of rhythm.

lines.zh: 我掉了几片叶子，其实是腿。
lines.en: I seem to shed leaves, but they are legs.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，边缘的锯齿都收着。
lines.en: I curl tight with my jagged edges tucked in.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的颜色褪了一点。
lines.en: The blow makes my color fade a shade.

lines.zh: 我一瘸一拐地往叶背挪。
lines.en: I limp toward the leaf's underside.

lines.zh: 另一只叶虫爬来，靠着我停下。
lines.en: Another leaf insect climbs over and halts by me.

lines.zh: 一片嫩叶凑到面前，我忍不住探头。
lines.en: A tender leaf comes close and I cannot help leaning.

lines.zh: 那叶子的边还卷着，最新鲜。
lines.en: Its edge is still curled, the freshest kind.

lines.zh: 我闻出这是刚长出来的，很软。
lines.en: I smell that it just grew, and it is soft.

lines.zh: 你摇了摇枝条，我的头跟着转。
lines.en: You shake the twig and my head follows it.

lines.zh: 叶面上有水珠，我更想吃了。
lines.en: There are droplets on it, which makes it better.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，还是装作路过。
lines.en: I drift over, still pretending to be passing by.

lines.zh: 那片叶子晃得很有节奏，我上钩了。
lines.en: The leaf sways in rhythm and I am caught.

lines.zh: 我把嘴贴上叶缘，先咬了一小口。
lines.en: I set my mouth to the edge and take a small bite.

lines.zh: 我本来不想动，可它太嫩了。
lines.en: I meant to stay put, but it is too tender.

lines.zh: 你递来的叶子，比林子里的都绿。
lines.en: The leaf you offer is greener than any here.

lines.zh: 我撞上树枝，立刻僵成叶片。
lines.en: I hit a twig and freeze into leaf shape.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫撞过来，把我撞歪了。
lines.en: A beetle blunders into me and knocks me askew.

lines.zh: 我从叶上滑落，半空翻了个身。
lines.en: I slip off the leaf and flip in midair.

lines.zh: 撞到蛛丝，我缠了几根腿。
lines.en: I hit a strand of web and tangle a leg.

lines.zh: 你的肩蹭过枝头，我被带得乱晃。
lines.en: Your shoulder brushes the branch and sets me swinging.

lines.zh: 两只叶虫碰上，都以为对方是叶子。
lines.en: Two leaf insects meet, each taking the other for a leaf.

lines.zh: 我撞进鸟窝边，赶紧退了出来。
lines.en: I blunder by a nest and back out fast.

lines.zh: 风把我推到树干上，我贴着不动。
lines.en: Wind slaps me to the trunk; I cling and hold.

lines.zh: 我踩空了一节枝，掉了半尺。
lines.en: I miss a length of branch and drop a hand's width.

lines.zh: 雨点砸下来，我被打得偏了方向。
lines.en: A raindrop hits and knocks me off course.

lines.zh: 我用前腿敲枝，她回了三下。
lines.en: I tap the twig with a foreleg; she answers three times.

lines.zh: 我们并排在叶背，像同一片叶的两半。
lines.en: We lie paired beneath the leaf like two halves of one.

lines.zh: 她先动了一下，我才挪近半步。
lines.en: She stirs first, and I edge half a step closer.

lines.zh: 求偶时我摇得比风更慢。
lines.en: Courting, I sway slower than the wind does.

lines.zh: 我们互相碰了碰触角，就懂了。
lines.en: We touch antennae and that is all it takes.

lines.zh: 两只叶虫贴在枝上，绿得一样。
lines.en: Two leaf insects press to the branch, alike in green.

lines.zh: 她选中了我这片枝，我留了下来。
lines.en: She chose this branch and so I stayed.

lines.zh: 我的边缘蹭着她的边缘。
lines.en: My edges brush against her edges.

lines.zh: 林子这么大，我们只找对方。
lines.en: The wood is vast and we look only for each other.

lines.zh: 这一树的嫩叶够养我们的幼虫。
lines.en: This tree's young leaves can feed our nymphs.

lines.zh: 你把我捧起来，我还是叶子的样子。
lines.en: You scoop me up and I stay leaf-shaped.

lines.zh: 我僵在你手心，一动不敢动。
lines.en: I freeze in your palm, not daring to move.

lines.zh: 被举到光下，我的绿色藏不住了。
lines.en: Held to the light, my green gives me away.

lines.zh: 我搭在你指上，腿勾着你的皮。
lines.en: I perch on your finger, legs hooked to skin.

lines.zh: 离开树枝，我有点不知道往哪爬。
lines.en: Off the branch, I am not sure which way to crawl.

lines.zh: 你把我放进盒子，里面全是叶。
lines.en: You put me in a box full of leaves.

lines.zh: 我试着装死，把腿都收起来。
lines.en: I try playing dead and fold all my legs in.

lines.zh: 你的手很暖，不像树皮。
lines.en: Your hand is warm, unlike bark.

lines.zh: 我又被放回枝上，赶紧抓住。
lines.en: Set back on the branch, I grab hold fast.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我假装是片叶。
lines.en: You are watching me; I pretend to be a leaf.

lines.zh: 一只小虫落在叶上，我盯住它。
lines.en: A small bug lands on the leaf and I mark it.

lines.zh: 有东西在啃我的树，我听见了。
lines.en: Something is chewing my tree and I hear it.

lines.zh: 那只毛虫比我的腿还粗。
lines.en: That caterpillar is thicker than my legs.

lines.zh: 我锁定了叶背上那团蠕动的绿。
lines.en: I lock onto the squirming green under the leaf.

lines.zh: 一只蚜虫挤在嫩芽上，太近了。
lines.en: An aphid crowds the bud, far too close.

lines.zh: 你砍的那棵树，我要守着。
lines.en: That tree you are chopping is mine to guard.

lines.zh: 我看见那只鸟在找虫，先记住了。
lines.en: I see the bird hunting bugs and I remember it.

lines.zh: 目标在叶脉尽头，我顺着走过去。
lines.en: The target is at the vein's end; I walk toward it.

lines.zh: 有只甲虫想占我的枝，我盯上了它。
lines.en: A beetle wants my branch, so I fix on it.

lines.zh: 它的影子先到，我看见了影子。
lines.en: Its shadow arrives first, and I see the shadow.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向它，尽量不像在动。
lines.en: I turn toward it as slowly as I can.

lines.zh: 这一片林子，我认得每只害虫。
lines.en: In this wood I know every pest by sight.

lines.zh: 我停在叶柄上，等它走进范围。
lines.en: I stop on the petiole and wait for it to come close.

lines.zh: 它一咬叶子，我就知道它在哪。
lines.en: Each bite it takes tells me where it is.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过去，慢慢挪近。
lines.en: I turn my body and creep nearer.

lines.zh: 我算着叶子的弯度，选好落点。
lines.en: I gauge the leaf's bend and pick my landing.

lines.zh: 翅膀没动，我全靠腿靠近。
lines.en: My wings stay shut; I close in on legs alone.

lines.zh: 它抬头时，我立刻停住。
lines.en: It looks up and I stop at once.

lines.zh: 我们之间只隔一条叶脉。
lines.en: Only one vein lies between us.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，连风都不敢用。
lines.en: I watch it and do not even spend the wind.

lines.zh: 它往叶尖去，我从边上绕。
lines.en: It heads for the tip; I go around the edge.

lines.zh: 我的触角几乎贴着叶面。
lines.en: My antennae almost touch the leaf.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就能碰到它。
lines.en: A little closer and I can reach it.

lines.zh: 它没发现，因为我看起来只是叶。
lines.en: It has not noticed, because I look like a leaf.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住毛虫的背。
lines.en: I bite down on the caterpillar's back.

lines.zh: 前腿一夹，把虫子按在叶上。
lines.en: My forelegs clamp the bug to the leaf.

lines.zh: 我甩了一下头，把它扔下去。
lines.en: I jerk my head and throw it off.

lines.zh: 它反咬我，我的边缘被咬掉一点。
lines.en: It bites back and takes a notch from my edge.

lines.zh: 我咬得很轻，却咬在要紧处。
lines.en: My bite is light but lands where it matters.

lines.zh: 打斗中我还得像叶子一样晃。
lines.en: Mid-fight I still must sway like a leaf.

lines.zh: 我用锯齿状的腿卡住它。
lines.en: I pin it with my jagged legs.

lines.zh: 它挣开了，我立刻贴回枝上。
lines.en: It breaks free and I press back to the branch.

lines.zh: 我不吃它，只是把它赶出这片叶。
lines.en: I do not eat it; I just drive it off my leaf.

lines.zh: 打完我检查了一圈，边缘破了。
lines.en: Afterward I check myself: my edge is torn.

lines.zh: 林子里多了一只绿得发亮的虫。
lines.en: The forest gains a bug bright with green.

lines.zh: 我从卵壳里出来，周围都是叶。
lines.en: I leave the egg case surrounded by leaves.

lines.zh: 我落在叶背，第一件事是装叶子。
lines.en: On the leaf's underside, I first pretend to be it.

lines.zh: 树影太多，我花了很久才找到位置。
lines.en: So many shadows; finding my spot took a while.

lines.zh: 我第一次摇动身体，风正好过来。
lines.en: My first sway comes just as the wind does.

lines.zh: 这片林子有音乐，我听见了。
lines.en: This wood has music and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我出生时就是绿的，省了很多事。
lines.en: I was born green, which saves a lot of trouble.

lines.zh: 附近有只鸟，我选择更低的一枝。
lines.en: A bird is near, so I choose a lower branch.

lines.zh: 我顺着树干往上，找到一处叶隙。
lines.en: I climb the trunk and find a gap in the leaves.

lines.zh: 林子接纳了我，虽然没人看见。
lines.en: The wood takes me in, though no one sees.

lines.zh: 树烧起来了，我的绿被烤焦。
lines.en: The tree catches fire and my green singes.

lines.zh: 我从高枝落下，摔在落叶上。
lines.en: I fall from a high branch onto the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 水里我漂着，像一片真叶子。
lines.en: In the water I float like a real leaf.

lines.zh: 爆响过后，我贴在树干上发懵。
lines.en: After the blast I cling to the trunk, dazed.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过叶隙，削掉我半片边。
lines.en: An arrow cuts through the gap and shaves my edge.

lines.zh: 一股力量把我从伪装里拽出来。
lines.en: A force drags me out of my disguise.

lines.zh: 三天没吃到嫩叶，我瘦得发干。
lines.en: Three days without tender leaves and I dry thin.

lines.zh: 闪电照亮整片林子，我忘了装叶子。
lines.en: Lightning lights the wood and I forget to be a leaf.

lines.zh: 脚下枝空了，我一路掉进黑里。
lines.en: The branch ends and I fall into the dark.
